what: Sanmina builds electronics for other companies: circuit boards, enclosures, cable assemblies and finished systems for communications networks, medical devices, industrial equipment and defence.
customers: Communications equipment makers, medical device companies, industrial manufacturers and defence contractors.
money: assembling printed circuit boards and complete systems
enclosures, cables, optical modules and repair services
moat: Manufacturing lines qualified for regulated products such as medical devices and defence electronics, where moving production means requalifying with the regulator.
risks: A 2.6% net margin, normal for contract manufacturing but unforgiving
Revenue is concentrated in a few large customers who can move volumes
Only four analysts cover the stock
opportunities: 22.6 times earnings and 15 times free cash flow with $540M of free cash flow
Revenue nearly doubled to $14.5B over the last twelve months after the ZT Systems acquisition
Analysts see about 62% upside, and the AI data centre systems business is growing quickly
watch: Revenue from data centre and cloud customers and the operating margin.
